data.description:
/// Top 5 Finalist in the World Game Development Championships, (Community Design Award) ///

Welcome to MYX Virtual Events Platform, a next-gen VR experience Exclusive to the Quest, MYX will take you on a night-out experience you will never forget!

With all these features AND MORE - we know you will love what we are creating; 

- Sprawling open world city, 
- Full Body Avatars, 
- Real World Nightclub Digital Twins, 
- Top Brands opening storefronts, 
- Full Internet browser in game, 
- Luxury Private Apartments, 
- Real Live DJ streaming Sets into the venues, 
- Minimal loading Screens, 
- Huge instances (up to 100 players per instance) 
- Incredible next gen-graphics, 
- unbeatable community, 

A small passionate team running this for more 5 years of development comes to you in a free to play experience. 

What more could you ask for! 

MYX is currently in Early Access so some features and venues are still in development but we will release them as they become ready to share, ensuring this world will continuously unfold as you play over time.  But most of all Enjoy MYX - We made it with love for you. :) 

Us@funder.studio
